about.title: About me
about.description: I'm a lifelong learner, fascinated by learning and personal growth. Beyond technology, I'm interested in all subjects surrounding society, with particular emphasis on economics, sociology, and philosophy. I completed technical web development training at SENAI in 2022, but after finishing the course, I stepped away from the IT field due to my interests in economics. However, in 2025, I looked at the IT market with fresh eyes and a new perspective. Now more experienced and knowledgeable about the diverse opportunities in the sector, I returned to fullstack development learning and began my training with a focus on specializing in Business Intelligence & Machine Learning development.

educationItems.institution: Senai Centro de Treinamento da Tecnologia da Informação - CTTI MG
educationItems.description: Technical training in web development covering both frontend and backend technologies. Practical hands-on experience with modern web development frameworks and tools for creating dynamic web applications.
Secondary education completion with excellent performance. Final grade average: 16/20. Outstanding achievement in Computer Applications discipline with special recognition for superior performance.

educationItems.course: Técnico Especialista em Tecnologias e Programação de Sistemas de Informação
educationItems.description: Advanced specialist training in Information Systems Technologies and Programming. Comprehensive curriculum covering web development (server-side and client-side), database design, relational and NoSQL databases, mobile applications for Android, network communication configuration, information system analysis and planning, algorithm development, security and occupational health standards in IT, and object-oriented programming.

professionalItems.description: Development of visual and graphical programming solutions for internal applications. Work involves creating interfaces, optimizing frontend code, and integrating with existing systems.

My role involves community leadership and university representation within one of the largest technology education ecosystems in Latin America. As part of the program, I participate in initiatives to promote technology education, community engagement, and professional development for participants.

As a part-time audiovisual technician, I am responsible for setting up and managing audiovisual equipment for events and productions. This includes configuring sound systems, video equipment, and ensuring smooth operation during live events. My role also involves troubleshooting technical issues and collaborating with event organizers to meet their audiovisual needs.
